rotation.method: Unattended-run override: NO rotation. Working set = ALL 3 core + ENTIRE 34-keyword medicine pool (37 total). Each expanded into 1-3 siblings. Expansions shifted vs 2026-10-08 toward new angles (different vendors, specialties, outlets). Query budget allowed to exceed 32. No WebSearch used in planning.
rotation.notes: Scope per sources.json medicine _note: clinical/treatment only (trials, FDA 510(k)/De Novo/CE, hospital deployment, diagnosis/imaging, disease-specific drug discovery, SaMD, EHR/documentation, telehealth, prior auth, patient safety/bias/liability). Disease-unspecified biology/protein-structure models belong to science - drop unless a named disease/patient/clinician is reached. Exclude funding/M&A/personnel, supplement ads, wellness-app promos. SAFETY: never pick pathogen gain-of-function / bioweapon-readable stories (swap, don't reword); vaccine/antibiotic design for treatment is fine. Fetch tips: JAMA RSS dates are issue dates (verify via Crossref); Korean feeds are KST without offset. Prefer outlet RSS over site: search for recency.

recently_published_avoid._comment: Medicine cards published 2026-10-08 (section's first day). Do NOT re-collect these stories or same-event follow-ups without a new decision/result; steer to new angles.

recently_published_avoid.steer: Already heavy on radiology/imaging (2 of 5) and Radiology Business/Healthcare Dive. Today favor: drug trials with named disease, cardiology/ophthalmology/pathology/dermatology, EHR/Epic/Oracle, prior auth/payers, mental-health chatbot regulation, LLM clinical decision support RCTs, surgical robotics, patient safety/liability, nursing, and Korean outlets (식약처 허가, 수가, 병원 도입). Prefer journals (NEJM AI, Lancet Digital Health, JAMA Netw Open, Nature Medicine, npj Digital Medicine) and STAT/Endpoints/Fierce.
